findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Give every clip a poster frame: in the study of 100 Sites of the Day only 31% had one, and the blank or grey boxes before the clips played were recorded as faults (references/imagery.md §11).

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: The margins differ: 132px on the left, 156px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.
